elements.name: street lamps as soft blurred lights
lit shop fronts as soft blurred lights

wrong_setting: Generic Western/European-style street with uniform low-rise rowhouses, modern sedans and wide tidy sidewalks; nothing reads as Addis Ababa (no blue-and-white minibuses or taxis, no Ethiopian storefronts or Amharic-style signage shapes, no hilly eucalyptus-lined streetscape).
notes: Repaint full-bleed without the white paper margin and ragged rounded edges, make the street recognisably Addis Ababa with blue-and-white minibuses and local storefronts, and soften everything into out-of-focus light blooms with visible reflections on the glass.
